scope: Read-only private-runner delta and offline mock-evidence review; no prepare, build, Docker, API, broker or installed-state operation executed by reviewer.
resolved_findings: Imported daily evidence/host fixture modules are now mandatory exact-hash test support, included in image proof without selecting additional full suites.
verified: Separate candidate requires actual boolean candidate/approval flags, aware VALIDATED_AT, dictionary surface, no FROZEN_AT, and exact active_forward_cutoff context.
Archived canonical and readiness-reference bytes must equal the fixed approved cbff hash and currently observed installed hash; active cutoff is never derived from candidate validation time.
Prepare and build bind the same three references; changed runner/context/archive/scan/active identity causes refusal. Old prepared state cannot be reused with this runner.
Only three exact committed public JSON fixtures enter disposable /tmp via stdin, with path-set and byte-hash validation plus exclusive creation before pytest; no production mounts or /app writes.

Prior eleven suites retained plus lifecycle, active-freeze and generator suites; selected files and imported support are image-hash verified. Exact fresh JUnit determines counts; historical results are not copied.

Existing archive validation, exact false-positive scan matching, resource checks, unique tag, Docker readonly/network-none/capability constraints, cleanup identity and installed before/after preservation remain unchanged.
limitations: Mocked tests establish orchestration contracts, not a successful final-source image build.
Root must supply a final committed source; fresh full-context scan must contain no unresolved findings and its exact digest must be approved before build.
Capacity/active identity, source/image/labels, exclusions, recomputed candidate surface and tests must pass during actual bounded build.
No deployment, startup, new cutoff, credential change or automatic reuse of expired activation helpers is authorized by this review.
